notes: Fixed why app updates never arrived: the update sheet threw a JavaScript error the moment it tried to appear, so the check found the update, wrote the patch notes, and never showed you anything
The update sheet now opens with the real patch notes for the version you are installing, and Download & install still stages it so a playing song is never interrupted
Renaming an album no longer leaves a ghost copy of the old name behind — every song carrying that album tag moves with the rename, not just the ones the album already knew about
Lyrics for brand-new releases: multi-artist credits like "A & B" are now matched against how LRCLIB files the song, and a throttled request is retried instead of giving up
Searching for lyrics by hand now lists the matches it found (closest length first) instead of silently picking one for you
Smoother scrolling everywhere: one scroll engine per list so animations cannot fight each other, duration scaled to distance, and the back-to-top button fades in with a real transition
